Leiomyoma: The presence of a well-circumscribed mass with a thin fibrous capsule, lobules of mature fatty tissue harbouring multiple variable sized nodules of smooth muscle fibres, and smooth muscle fibres arranged in broad interlacing fascicles, along with positivity for smooth muscle actin and desmin, and symptoms of intermittent abdominal pain and abdominal distension, are consistent with leiomyoma.
Desmoid Tumor: The presence of a mass in the right iliac fossa, broad interlacing fascicles of smooth muscle fibres, and a history of previous surgery, are consistent with desmoid tumor.
